name: manual_2443b1
claim: Make a live pair seat's target a pure decision function (facts in, decision out) and hand-write the lifecycle around it: the allowlist vet bans try and attribute calls by design, so a try/finally lifecycle can never be a pair target.

decisions.notes: Turn 5 of the pair loop: the first candidate target failed the vet on attribute calls; extracting _launch_decision made the seat's turn pass 7 failed cases to 0 for about 0.0025 USD while the lifecycle was written by hand.

rationale: Turn 5 of the pair loop: the first candidate target failed the vet on attribute calls; extracting _launch_decision made the seat's turn pass 7 failed cases to 0 for about 0.0025 USD while the lifecycle was written by hand.
